content: मध्यंदिन {%a.%} .²1 Middle, central. .²2 Meridional, belonging to noon (also मध्यंदिनीय). .{@-नम्@} .²1 The mid-day (the third division of the day out of five); अथ यत् संप्रति मध्यंदिने <ls>Ch. Up. 2. 9. 5</ls>. .²2 The time of the day between 16 to 20 Ghaṭakās; मध्यंदिने विष्णुररीन्द्रपाणिः <ls>Bhāg. 6. 8. 20</ls>.
